description: Night-by-night sleep over a range, one compact row per night filed under the date the user woke up: start_local/end_local as local 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'; hours of sleep, deep, light, REM and awake (and naps); sleep score with its quality and factor ratings; average HR, stress and respiration (avg/low/high); SpO2 average/lowest; sleep need vs baseline in minutes with what drove it (training load, e.g. HIGH_ACWR_AND_CHRONIC, HRV, sleep history, naps) and next night's need; Garmin's insights. For last night alone use get_readiness or get_sleep; for trends over weeks or months use summarize_wellness. Up to 92 days per call: pass a period (e.g. last_7_days, last_30_days, this_month) or start_date/end_date. detail='full' returns Garmin's raw records.

detail.description: compact (default) keeps the meaningful fields in readable units; full returns Garmin's raw payload.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to start_date. Max span 92 days.

period.description: Named period resolved in the user's time zone (weeks start Monday). Use instead of start_date/end_date.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Required unless period is given.

name: get_sleep_summaries
title: Sleep summaries
